(๑•̀ㅂ•́)૭☒|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] dialogue on Wave 7 ([[April Fools 2022#Narration|April Fools 2022 Hardcore]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Hefty''' is a tanky enemy that appears in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] and [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] modes. It has higher health and [[Defense]] than every enemy that appeared before it, though it is also slower than all of them. The '''Hefty''' can be spawned by the [[Mystery]]. ==Logbook Description== "''The Hefty are those who are completely consumed by the Void Gems. Gems sprout from their bodies as their skin turns to crystal. The souls trapped within their bodies are chained down by magic as the transformation causes them to fall out with nothing organic to hold onto.''" ==Appearance== {{Tabber |Modern |The '''Hefty''' has grey skin. Its body is covered in multiple purple crystals. It has veins on its arms and a hole in its torso with a chain coming out of it. It has two animations it can pick from. |Legacy |{{Tabber |Current |The current legacy version of the '''Hefty''' has dark red reflective skin. Its torso, legs, wristbands and sleeves were made out of corroded metal. It is faceless. |Version 1 |The first version of the '''Hefty''' had green reflective skin. Its torso, legs, wristbands and sleeves were made out of corroded metal. It had a sad face. It walked with its head titled downwards. It looked similar to the [[Chained Boss]]. }} }} ==Strategy== *While fairly tough for its debut, the '''Hefty''' can easily be handled by most early game towers, such as the [[Pyromancer]], [[Engineer]], [[Saboteur]] and [[Operator]]. **As [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode awards much less cash, completely relying on the [[Pyromancer]] is not recommended. *The '''Hefty's''' [[Defense]] is negligible, as it is too low to have an impact on most towers. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Previous Variants}} Hefty0.png|First version (29 October 2020 – 8 May 2021) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseHefty.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} Hardcore Rework Trailer - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Hefty''' in the game trailer. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} V1.86.0UpdateLog1.png|'''Hefty''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Concept Art}} HeftyCA.png|'''Hefty''' on its concept art. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} ModernHeftyiconIG.png|'''Hefty''' on its [[Index]] icon. IndexHefty.png|Legacy '''Hefty''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *Weirdly, the health of the '''Hefty''' was increased in [[MEGA Servers]], despite it not being able to spawn in a [[MEGA Servers|MEGA Server]] without admin commands. *The legacy version of the '''Hefty''' looks similar to the [[Rusted]]. **Its original appearance looked similar to the unreleased and current version of [[Chained Boss]]. *The '''Hefty''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''29 October 2020''' - [[Overhaul v1.0|Overhaul v1.0.0]] **'''Hefty''' added. *'''8 May 2021''' - [[Overhaul v1.3|Overhaul v1.3.0]] **Appearance changed. **Health increased from 15 to 20. **Defense changed from 3 to 25%. *'''5 June 2026''' - [[v2.0.0]] **Modern version added. ***Appearance changed. ***Now has 50 health in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. ***Now has 75 health in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode. ***Now has 45 health in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. ***Now gives {{Money|30}} on death in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode. ***Now gives {{Money|25}} on death in [[Voidcore Mode|Voidcore]] mode. **[[Logbooks|Logbook]] description added. {{Hardcore|[[Odd]] & [[Swift]]|Wave 1|Hefty|Wave 4|[[Mandrake]]|Wave 8}} {{Voidcore|[[Odd]] & [[Swift]]|Wave 1|Hefty|Wave 4|[[Cursed Skeleton]]|Wave 8}} {{ZombieNavBox}} [[Category:Early-Game]]
